<CHAPTER id="dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t" title="Magic Items S T">

# Magic Items (S-T) {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:MagicItemsST}

[![Image](https://www.dndbeyond.com/attachments/thumbnails/1/216/650/866/c7b-fullpage-2.jpg)](https://www.dndbeyond.com/attachments/1/216/c7b-fullpage-2.jpg)

## Magic Items (S) {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:MagicItemsS}

### [Saddle of the Cavalier](#ref:magic_item:5396-saddle-of-the-cavalier "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5396-saddle-of-the-cavalier") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SaddleoftheCavalierrefmagicitem5396saddleofthecavalierhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5396saddleofthecavalier}

_Wondrous item, uncommon_

While in this saddle on a mount, you can’t be dismounted against your will if you’re conscious, and attack rolls against the mount have disadvantage.

### [Scarab of Protection](#ref:magic_item:4751-scarab-of-protection "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4751-scarab-of-protection") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:ScarabofProtectionrefmagicitem4751scarabofprotectionhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4751scarabofprotection}

_Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement)_

If you hold this beetle-shaped medallion in your hand for 1 round, an inscription appears on its surface revealing its magical nature. It provides two benefits while it is on your person:

- You have advantage on saving throws against spells.
- The scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an undead creature, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.

[![Sending Stones and Scarab of Protection](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-072-sending-scarab.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-072-sending-scarab.png)

### [Scimitar of Speed](#ref:magic_item:4752-scimitar-of-speed "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4752-scimitar-of-speed") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:ScimitarofSpeedrefmagicitem4752scimitarofspeedhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4752scimitarofspeed}

_Weapon (scimitar), very rare (requires attunement)_

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a bonus action on each of your turns.

### [Scroll of Protection](#ref:magic_item:5398-scroll-of-protection "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5398-scroll-of-protection") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:ScrollofProtectionrefmagicitem5398scrollofprotectionhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5398scrollofprotection}

_Scroll, rare_

Each _scroll of protection_ works against a specific type of creature chosen by the DM or determined randomly by rolling on the following table.

| d100  | Creature Type |
| ----- | ------------- |
| 01–10 | Aberrations   |
| 11–20 | Beasts        |
| 21–30 | Celestials    |
| 31–40 | Elementals    |
| 41–50 | Fey           |
| 51–75 | Fiends        |
| 76–80 | Plants        |
| 81–00 | Undead        |

Using an action to read the scroll encloses you in a invisible barrier that extends from you to form a 5-foot-radius, 10-foot-high cylinder. For 5 minutes, this barrier prevents creatures of the specified type from entering or affecting anything within the cylinder.

The cylinder moves with you and remains centered on you. However, if you move in such a way that a creature of the specified type would be inside the cylinder, the effect ends.

A creature can attempt to overcome the barrier by using an action to make a DC 15 Charisma check. On a success, the creature ceases to be affected by the barrier.

### [Sending Stones](#ref:magic_item:5402-sending-stones "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5402-sending-stones") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SendingStonesrefmagicitem5402sendingstoneshttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5402sendingstones}

_Wondrous item, uncommon_

_Sending stones_ come in pairs, with each smooth stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can use an action to cast the [**sending**](#ref:spell:2243-sending "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2243-sending") spell from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone and don’t cast the spell.

Once [**sending**](#ref:spell:2243-sending "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2243-sending") is cast through the stones, they can’t be used again until the next dawn. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.

### [Sentinel Shield](#ref:magic_item:5403-sentinel-shield "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5403-sentinel-shield") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SentinelShieldrefmagicitem5403sentinelshieldhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5403sentinelshield}

_Armor (shield), uncommon_

While holding this shield, you have advantage on initiative rolls and Wisdom ([**Perception**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#skills)) checks. The shield is emblazoned with a symbol of an eye.

### Shield, +1, +2, or +3 {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:Shield12or3}

_Armor (shield), [**uncommon (+1)**](#ref:magic_item:4753-shield-1 "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4753-shield-1"), [**rare (+2)**](#ref:magic_item:5157-shield-2 "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5157-shield-2"), or [**very rare (+3)**](#ref:magic_item:5158-shield-3 "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5158-shield-3")_

While holding this shield, you have a bonus to AC determined by the shield’s rarity. This bonus is in addition to the shield’s normal bonus to AC.

### [Shield of Missile Attraction](#ref:magic_item:4754-shield-of-missile-attraction "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4754-shield-of-missile-attraction") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:ShieldofMissileAttractionrefmagicitem4754shieldofmissileattractionhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4754shieldofmissileattraction}

### [Slippers of Spider Climbing](#ref:magic_item:4755-slippers-of-spider-climbing "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4755-slippers-of-spider-climbing") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SlippersofSpiderClimbingrefmagicitem4755slippersofspiderclimbinghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4755slippersofspiderclimbing}

[![Top to Bottom: Slippers of Spider Climbing, Shieldof Missile Attraction, and Spellguard Shield](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-073-slippers-missiles-spellguard.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-073-slippers-missiles-spellguard.png)

### [Sovereign Glue](#ref:magic_item:4756-sovereign-glue "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4756-sovereign-glue") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SovereignGluerefmagicitem4756sovereigngluehttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4756sovereignglue}

_Wondrous item, legendary_

This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with [**oil of slipperiness**](#ref:magic_item:4689-oil-of-slipperiness "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4689-oil-of-slipperiness"). When found, a container contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. The glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of [**universal solvent**](#ref:magic_item:4785-universal-solvent "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4785-universal-solvent") or [**oil of etherealness**](#ref:magic_item:4687-oil-of-etherealness "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4687-oil-of-etherealness"), or with a [**wish**](#ref:spell:2303-wish "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2303-wish") spell.

### [Spell Scroll](#ref:magic_item:5418-spell-scroll "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5418-spell-scroll") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SpellScrollrefmagicitem5418spellscrollhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5418spellscroll}

_Scroll, varies_

A _spell scroll_ bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your class’s spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without providing any material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell’s normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade, and it crumbles to dust. If the casting is interrupted, the scroll is not lost.

If the spell is on your class’s spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you must make an ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast it successfully. The DC equals 10 + the spell’s level. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.

Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade, and the scroll itself crumbles to dust.

The level of the spell on the scroll determines the spell’s saving throw DC and attack bonus, as well as the scroll’s rarity, as shown in the Spell Scroll table.

**Spell Scroll**

| Spell Level                                                                                                                    | Rarity    | Save DC | Attack Bonus |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- | ------- | ------------ |
| [**Cantrip**](#ref:magic_item:4758-spell-scroll-0-cantrip "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4758-spell-scroll-0-cantrip") | Common    | 13      | +5           |
| [**1st**](#ref:magic_item:5161-spell-scroll-1st-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5161-spell-scroll-1st-level")     | Common    | 13      | +5           |
| [**2nd**](#ref:magic_item:5162-spell-scroll-2nd-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5162-spell-scroll-2nd-level")     | Uncommon  | 13      | +5           |
| [**3rd**](#ref:magic_item:5163-spell-scroll-3rd-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5163-spell-scroll-3rd-level")     | Uncommon  | 15      | +7           |
| [**4th**](#ref:magic_item:5164-spell-scroll-4th-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5164-spell-scroll-4th-level")     | Rare      | 15      | +7           |
| [**5th**](#ref:magic_item:5165-spell-scroll-5th-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5165-spell-scroll-5th-level")     | Rare      | 17      | +9           |
| [**6th**](#ref:magic_item:5166-spell-scroll-6th-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5166-spell-scroll-6th-level")     | Very rare | 17      | +9           |
| [**7th**](#ref:magic_item:5167-spell-scroll-7th-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5167-spell-scroll-7th-level")     | Very rare | 18      | +10          |
| [**8th**](#ref:magic_item:5168-spell-scroll-8th-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5168-spell-scroll-8th-level")     | Very rare | 18      | +10          |
| [**9th**](#ref:magic_item:5169-spell-scroll-9th-level "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5169-spell-scroll-9th-level")     | Legendary | 19      | +11          |

A wizard spell on a _spell scroll_ can be copied just as spells in spellbooks can be copied. When a spell is copied from a _spell scroll_, the copier must succeed on an Intelligence ([**Arcana**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#skills)) check with a DC equal to 10 + the spell’s level. If the check succeeds, the spell is successfully copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the _spell scroll_ is destroyed.

### [Spellguard Shield](#ref:magic_item:4757-spellguard-shield "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4757-spellguard-shield") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SpellguardShieldrefmagicitem4757spellguardshieldhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4757spellguardshield}

_Armor (shield), very rare (requires attunement)_

While holding this shield, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks have disadvantage against you.

### [Sphere of Annihilation](#ref:magic_item:4759-sphere-of-annihilation "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4759-sphere-of-annihilation") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SphereofAnnihilationrefmagicitem4759sphereofannihilationhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4759sphereofannihilation}

_Wondrous item, legendary_

This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.

The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an artifact is susceptible to damage from a _sphere of annihilation_, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn’t wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes 4d10 force damage.

The sphere is stationary until someone controls it. If you are within 60 feet of an uncontrolled sphere, you can use an action to make a DC 25 Intelligence ([**Arcana**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#skills)) check. On a success, the sphere levitates in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 × your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). On a failure, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you. A creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking 4d10 force damage.

If you attempt to control a sphere that is under another creature’s control, you make an Intelligence ([**Arcana**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#skills)) check contested by the other creature’s Intelligence ([**Arcana**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#skills)) check. The winner of the contest gains control of the sphere and can levitate it as normal.

If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal, such as that created by the [**gate**](#ref:spell:2119-gate "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2119-gate") spell, or an extradimensional space, such as that within a [**portable hole**](#ref:magic_item:4699-portable-hole "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4699-portable-hole"), the DM determines randomly what happens, using the following table.

| d100  | Result                                                                                                                             |
| ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 01–50 | The sphere is destroyed.                                                                                                           |
| 51–85 | The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space.                                                            |
| 86–00 | A spatial rift sends each creature and object within 180 feet of the sphere, including the sphere, to a random plane of existence. |

### [Staff of Charming](#ref:magic_item:4760-staff-of-charming "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4760-staff-of-charming") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StaffofCharmingrefmagicitem4760staffofcharminghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4760staffofcharming}

While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 10 charges to cast [**charm person**](#ref:spell:2025-charm-person "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2025-charm-person"), [**command**](#ref:spell:2032-command "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2032-command"), or [**comprehend languages**](#ref:spell:2035-comprehend-languages "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2035-comprehend-languages") from it using your spell save DC. The staff can also be used as a magic quarterstaff.

If you are holding the staff and fail a saving throw against an enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. The staff regains 1d8 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical [**quarterstaff**](#ref:equipment:12-quarterstaff "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/12-quarterstaff").

### [Staff of Power](#ref:magic_item:4764-staff-of-power "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4764-staff-of-power") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StaffofPowerrefmagicitem4764staffofpowerhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4764staffofpower}

_Staff, very rare (requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard)_

[![Staffs Left to Right: Insects,Healing, Power, Magi, and Frost](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-076-staff-insects-healing-power-magi-frost.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-076-staff-insects-healing-power-magi-frost.png)

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls.

The staff has 20 charges for the following properties. The staff regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

_**Power Strike.**_ When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 1d6 force damage to the target.

_**Spells.**_ While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack bonus: [**cone of cold**](#ref:spell:2037-cone-of-cold "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2037-cone-of-cold") (5 charges), [**fireball**](#ref:spell:2102-fireball "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2102-fireball") (5th-level version, 5 charges), [**globe of invulnerability**](#ref:spell:2124-globe-of-invulnerability "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2124-globe-of-invulnerability") (6 charges), [**hold monster**](#ref:spell:2146-hold-monster "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2146-hold-monster") (5 charges), [**levitate**](#ref:spell:2165-levitate "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2165-levitate") (2 charges), [**lightning bolt**](#ref:spell:2167-lightning-bolt "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2167-lightning-bolt") (5th-level version, 5 charges), [**magic missile**](#ref:spell:2176-magic-missile "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2176-magic-missile") (1 charge), [**ray of enfeeblement**](#ref:spell:2225-ray-of-enfeeblement "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2225-ray-of-enfeeblement") (1 charge), or [**wall of force**](#ref:spell:2292-wall-of-force "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2292-wall-of-force") (5 charges).

_**Retributive Strike.**_ You can use an action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it.

You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 16 × the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

| Distance from Origin  | Damage                                 |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| 10 ft. away or closer | 8 × the number of charges in the staff |
| 11 to 20 ft. away     | 6 × the number of charges in the staff |
| 21 to 30 ft. away     | 4 × the number of charges in the staff |

### [Staff of the Magi](#ref:magic_item:4767-staff-of-the-magi "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4767-staff-of-the-magi") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StaffoftheMagirefmagicitem4767staffofthemagihttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4767staffofthemagi}

_Staff, legendary (requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard)_

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

The staff has 50 charges for the following properties. It regains 4d6 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 20, the staff regains 1d12 + 1 charges.

_**Spell Absorption.**_ While holding the staff, you have advantage on saving throws against spells. In addition, you can use your reaction when another creature casts a spell that targets only you. If you do, the staff absorbs the magic of the spell, canceling its effect and gaining a number of charges equal to the absorbed spell’s level. However, if doing so brings the staff’s total number of charges above 50, the staff explodes as if you activated its retributive strike (see below).

_**Spells.**_ While holding the staff, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spellcasting ability: [**conjure elemental**](#ref:spell:2041-conjure-elemental "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2041-conjure-elemental") (7 charges), [**dispel magic**](#ref:spell:2072-dispel-magic "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2072-dispel-magic") (3 charges), [**fireball**](#ref:spell:2102-fireball "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2102-fireball") (7th-level version, 7 charges), [**flaming sphere**](#ref:spell:2108-flaming-sphere "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2108-flaming-sphere") (2 charges), [**ice storm**](#ref:spell:2151-ice-storm "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2151-ice-storm") (4 charges), [**invisibility**](#ref:spell:2159-invisibility "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2159-invisibility") (2 charges), [**knock**](#ref:spell:2162-knock "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2162-knock") (2 charges), [**lightning bolt**](#ref:spell:2167-lightning-bolt "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2167-lightning-bolt") (7th-level version, 7 charges), [**passwall**](#ref:spell:2200-passwall "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2200-passwall") (5 charges), [**plane shift**](#ref:spell:2206-plane-shift "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2206-plane-shift") (7 charges), [**telekinesis**](#ref:spell:2273-telekinesis "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2273-telekinesis") (5 charges), [**wall of fire**](#ref:spell:2291-wall-of-fire "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2291-wall-of-fire") (4 charges), or [**web**](#ref:spell:2299-web "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2299-web") (2 charges).

You can also use an action to cast one of the following spells from the staff without using any charges: [**arcane lock**](#ref:spell:2003-arcane-lock "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2003-arcane-lock"), [**detect magic**](#ref:spell:2065-detect-magic "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2065-detect-magic"), [**enlarge/reduce**](#ref:spell:2084-enlarge-reduce "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2084-enlarge-reduce"), [**light**](#ref:spell:2166-light "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2166-light"), [**mage hand**](#ref:spell:2173-mage-hand "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2173-mage-hand"), or [**protection from evil and good**](#ref:spell:2221-protection-from-evil-and-good "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2221-protection-from-evil-and-good").

_**Retributive Strike.**_ You can use an action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it.

You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 16 × the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

| Distance from Origin  | Damage                                 |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| 10 ft. away or closer | 8 × the number of charges in the staff |
| 11 to 20 ft. away     | 6 × the number of charges in the staff |
| 21 to 30 ft. away     | 4 × the number of charges in the staff |

### [Staff of the Python](#ref:magic_item:4768-staff-of-the-python "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4768-staff-of-the-python") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StaffofthePythonrefmagicitem4768staffofthepythonhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4768staffofthepython}

_Staff, uncommon (requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or warlock)_

You can use an action to speak this staff’s command word and throw the staff on the ground within 10 feet of you. The staff becomes a [**giant constrictor snake**](#ref:monster:16878-giant-constrictor-snake "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16878-giant-constrictor-snake") (see the [Monster Manual](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/mm) for statistics) under your control and acts on its own initiative count. By using a bonus action to speak the command word again, you return the staff to its normal form in a space formerly occupied by the snake.

On your turn, you can mentally command the snake if it is within 60 feet of you and you aren’t [**incapacitated**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#incapacitatedcondition). You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its next turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location.

If the snake is reduced to 0 hit points, it dies and reverts to its staff form. The staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its hit points, it regains all of them.

### [Staff of the Woodlands](#ref:magic_item:4769-staff-of-the-woodlands "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4769-staff-of-the-woodlands") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StaffoftheWoodlandsrefmagicitem4769staffofthewoodlandshttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4769staffofthewoodlands}

_Staff, rare (requires attunement by a druid)_

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

The staff has 10 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical [**quarterstaff**](#ref:equipment:12-quarterstaff "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/12-quarterstaff").

_**Spells.**_ You can use an action to expend 1 or more of the staff’s charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: [**animal friendship**](#ref:spell:1993-animal-friendship "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/1993-animal-friendship") (1 charge), [**awaken**](#ref:spell:2008-awaken "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2008-awaken") (5 charges), [**barkskin**](#ref:spell:2011-barkskin "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2011-barkskin") (2 charges), [**locate animals or plants**](#ref:spell:2168-locate-animals-or-plants "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2168-locate-animals-or-plants") (2 charges), [**speak with animals**](#ref:spell:2258-speak-with-animals "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2258-speak-with-animals") (1 charge), [**speak with plants**](#ref:spell:2260-speak-with-plants "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2260-speak-with-plants") (3 charges), or [**wall of thorns**](#ref:spell:2295-wall-of-thorns "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2295-wall-of-thorns") (6 charges).

You can also use an action to cast the [**pass without trace**](#ref:spell:2201-pass-without-trace "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2201-pass-without-trace") spell from the staff without using any charges.

_**Tree Form.**_ You can use an action to plant one end of the staff in fertile earth and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius. The tree appears ordinary but radiates a faint aura of transmutation magic if targeted by [**detect magic**](#ref:spell:2065-detect-magic "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2065-detect-magic"). While touching the tree and using another action to speak its command word, you return the staff to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when it reverts to a staff.

[![Staffs Left to Right: Thunder andLightning, Withering, and Woodlands](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-079-lightning-withering-woodlands.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-079-lightning-withering-woodlands.png)

### [Staff of Thunder and Lightning](#ref:magic_item:4770-staff-of-thunder-and-lightning "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4770-staff-of-thunder-and-lightning") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StaffofThunderandLightningrefmagicitem4770staffofthunderandlightninghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4770staffofthunderandlightning}

_Staff, very rare (requires attunement)_

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties. When one of these properties is used, it can’t be used again until the next dawn.

_**Lightning.**_ When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra 2d6 lightning damage.

_**Thunder.**_ When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder, audible out to 300 feet. The target you hit must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become [**stunned**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#stunnedcondition) until the end of your next turn.

_**Lightning Strike.**_ You can use an action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff’s tip in a line that is 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in that line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

_**Thunderclap.**_ You can use an action to cause the staff to issue a deafening thunderclap, audible out to 600 feet. Each creature within 60 feet of you (not including you) must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 thunder damage and becomes [**deafened**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#deafenedcondition) for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn’t [**deafened**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#deafenedcondition).

_**Thunder and Lightning.**_ You can use an action to use the Lightning Strike and Thunderclap properties at the same time. Doing so doesn’t expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one.

### [Staff of Withering](#ref:magic_item:4771-staff-of-withering "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4771-staff-of-withering") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StaffofWitheringrefmagicitem4771staffofwitheringhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4771staffofwithering}

_Staff, rare (requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or warlock)_

This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

The staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage to the target. In addition, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage for 1 hour on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution.

### [Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals](#ref:magic_item:4772-stone-of-controlling-earth-elementals "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4772-stone-of-controlling-earth-elementals") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StoneofControllingEarthElementalsrefmagicitem4772stoneofcontrollingearthelementalshttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4772stoneofcontrollingearthelementals}

_Wondrous item, rare_

If the stone is touching the ground, you can use an action to speak its command word and summon an [**earth elemental**](#ref:monster:16853-earth-elemental "https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16853-earth-elemental"), as if you had cast the [**conjure elemental**](#ref:spell:2041-conjure-elemental "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2041-conjure-elemental") spell. The stone can’t be used this way again until the next dawn. The stone weighs 5 pounds.

[![Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-081-controlling-earth-elementals.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-081-controlling-earth-elementals.png)

### [Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone)](#ref:magic_item:4773-stone-of-good-luck-luckstone "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4773-stone-of-good-luck-luckstone") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:StoneofGoodLuckLuckstonerefmagicitem4773stoneofgoodluckluckstonehttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4773stoneofgoodluckluckstone}

_Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)_

While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

### [Sun Blade](#ref:magic_item:4774-sun-blade "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4774-sun-blade") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SunBladerefmagicitem4774sunbladehttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4774sunblade}

_Weapon (longsword), rare (requires attunement)_

This item appears to be a longsword hilt. While grasping the hilt, you can use a bonus action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence, or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic longsword has the [**finesse**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/equipment#finesse) property. If you are proficient with shortswords or longswords, you are proficient with the _sun blade_.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon, which deals radiant damage instead of slashing damage. When you hit an undead with it, that target takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage.

The sword’s luminous blade emits bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. The light is sunlight. While the blade persists, you can use an action to expand or reduce its radius of bright and dim light by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each.

[![Sun Blade](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-082-sun-blade.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-082-sun-blade.png)

### [Sword of Answering](#ref:magic_item:5506-sword-of-answering "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5506-sword-of-answering") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SwordofAnsweringrefmagicitem5506swordofansweringhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5506swordofanswering}

_Weapon (longsword), legendary (requires attunement by a creature with the same alignment as the sword)_

In the world of Greyhawk, only nine of these blades are known to exist. Each is patterned after the legendary sword Fragarach, which is variously translated as “Final Word.” Each of the nine swords has its own name and alignment, and each bears a different gem in its pommel.

| Name                                                                                                         | Alignment       | Gem        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------- | ---------- |
| [**Answerer**](#ref:magic_item:5452-answerer "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5452-answerer")          | Chaotic good    | Emerald    |
| [**Back Talker**](#ref:magic_item:5453-back-talker "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5453-back-talker") | Chaotic evil    | Jet        |
| [**Concluder**](#ref:magic_item:5454-concluder "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5454-concluder")       | Lawful neutral  | Amethyst   |
| [**Last Quip**](#ref:magic_item:5455-last-quip "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5455-last-quip")       | Chaotic neutral | Tourmaline |
| [**Rebutter**](#ref:magic_item:5456-rebutter "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5456-rebutter")          | Neutral good    | Topaz      |
| [**Replier**](#ref:magic_item:5457-replier "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5457-replier")             | Neutral         | Peridot    |
| [**Retorter**](#ref:magic_item:5458-retorter "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5458-retorter")          | Lawful good     | Aquamarine |
| [**Scather**](#ref:magic_item:5459-scather "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5459-scather")             | Lawful evil     | Garnet     |
| [**Squelcher**](#ref:magic_item:5460-squelcher "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5460-squelcher")       | Neutral evil    | Spinel     |

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this sword. In addition, while you hold the sword, you can use your reaction to make one melee attack with it against any creature in your reach that deals damage to you. You have advantage on the attack roll, and any damage dealt with this special attack ignores any damage immunity or resistance the target has.

### [Sword of Life Stealing](#ref:magic_item:5390-sword-of-life-stealing "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5390-sword-of-life-stealing") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SwordofLifeStealingrefmagicitem5390swordoflifestealinghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5390swordoflifestealing}

_Weapon (any sword), rare (requires attunement)_

When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 10 necrotic damage if it isn’t a construct or an undead. You also gain 10 [**temporary hit points**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/compendium/rules/basic-rules/combat#temporaryhitpoints).

[![Sword of Life Stealing and Sword of Sharpness](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-083-sword-lifestealing-sharpness.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-083-sword-lifestealing-sharpness.png)

### [Sword of Sharpness](#ref:magic_item:5391-sword-of-sharpness "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5391-sword-of-sharpness") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SwordofSharpnessrefmagicitem5391swordofsharpnesshttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5391swordofsharpness}

_Weapon (any sword that deals slashing damage), very rare (requires attunement)_

When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target.

When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 14 slashing damage. Then roll another d20. If you roll a 20, you lop off one of the target’s limbs, with the effect of such loss determined by the DM. If the creature has no limb to sever, you lop off a portion of its body instead.

In addition, you can speak the sword’s command word to cause the blade to shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. Speaking the command word again or sheathing the sword puts out the light.

### [Sword of Vengeance](#ref:magic_item:5505-sword-of-vengeance "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5505-sword-of-vengeance") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SwordofVengeancerefmagicitem5505swordofvengeancehttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5505swordofvengeance}

_Weapon (any sword), uncommon (requires attunement)_

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

_**Curse.**_ This sword is cursed and possessed by a vengeful spirit. Becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you are unwilling to part with the sword, keeping it on your person at all times. While attuned to this weapon, you have disadvantage on attack rolls made with weapons other than this one.

In addition, while the sword is on your person, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw whenever you take damage in combat. On a failed save, you must attack the creature that damaged you until you drop to 0 hit points or it does, or until you can’t reach the creature to make a melee attack against it.

You can break the curse in the usual ways. Alternatively, casting [**banishment**](#ref:spell:2010-banishment "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2010-banishment") on the sword forces the vengeful spirit to leave it. The sword then becomes a +1 weapon with no other properties.

### [Sword of Wounding](#ref:magic_item:5392-sword-of-wounding "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5392-sword-of-wounding") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:SwordofWoundingrefmagicitem5392swordofwoundinghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5392swordofwounding}

_Weapon (any sword), rare (requires attunement)_

Hit points lost to this weapon’s damage can be regained only through a short or long rest, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means.

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, you can wound the target. At the start of each of the wounded creature’s turns, it takes 1d4 necrotic damage for each time you’ve wounded it, and it can then make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect of all such wounds on itself on a success. Alternatively, the wounded creature, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can use an action to make a DC 15 Wisdom ([**Medicine**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#skills)) check, ending the effect of such wounds on it on a success.

## Magic Items (T) {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:MagicItemsT}

### [Talisman of Pure Good](#ref:magic_item:4778-talisman-of-pure-good "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4778-talisman-of-pure-good") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TalismanofPureGoodrefmagicitem4778talismanofpuregoodhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4778talismanofpuregood}

_Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement by a creature of good alignment)_

This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 radiant damage upon touching the talisman. An evil creature takes 8d6 radiant damage upon touching the talisman. Either sort of creature takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

If you are a good cleric or paladin, you can use the talisman as a [**holy symbol**](#ref:equipment:213-holy-symbol "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/213-holy-symbol"), and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.

The talisman has 7 charges. If you are wearing or holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge from it and choose one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of you. If the target is of evil alignment, a flaming fissure opens under it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the fissure and be destroyed, leaving no remains. The fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman disperses into motes of golden light and is destroyed.

### [Talisman of the Sphere](#ref:magic_item:4779-talisman-of-the-sphere "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4779-talisman-of-the-sphere") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TalismanoftheSphererefmagicitem4779talismanofthespherehttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4779talismanofthesphere}

_Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement)_

When you make an Intelligence ([**Arcana**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#skills)) check to control a [**sphere of annihilation**](#ref:magic_item:4759-sphere-of-annihilation "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4759-sphere-of-annihilation") while you are holding this talisman, you double your proficiency bonus on the check. In addition, when you start your turn with control over a [**sphere of annihilation**](#ref:magic_item:4759-sphere-of-annihilation "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4759-sphere-of-annihilation"), you can use an action to levitate it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 × your Intelligence modifier.

[![Talisman of the Sphere](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-084-talisman-sphere.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-084-talisman-sphere.png)

[![Talisman of Ultimate Evil](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-085-talisman-ultimate-evil.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-085-talisman-ultimate-evil.png)

### [Talisman of Ultimate Evil](#ref:magic_item:4780-talisman-of-ultimate-evil "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4780-talisman-of-ultimate-evil") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TalismanofUltimateEvilrefmagicitem4780talismanofultimateevilhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4780talismanofultimateevil}

_Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement by a creature of evil alignment)_

This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 necrotic damage upon touching the talisman. A good creature takes 8d6 necrotic damage upon touching the talisman. Either sort of creature takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

If you are an evil cleric or paladin, you can use the talisman as a [**holy symbol**](#ref:equipment:213-holy-symbol "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/213-holy-symbol"), and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.

The talisman has 6 charges. If you are wearing or holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge from the talisman and choose one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of you. If the target is of good alignment, a flaming fissure opens under it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the fissure and be destroyed, leaving no remains. The fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman dissolves into foul-smelling slime and is destroyed.

### [Tentacle Rod](#ref:magic_item:5408-tentacle-rod "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5408-tentacle-rod") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TentacleRodrefmagicitem5408tentaclerodhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5408tentaclerod}

_Rod, rare (requires attunement)_

Made by the drow, this rod is a magic weapon that ends in three rubbery tentacles. While holding the rod, you can use an action to direct each tentacle to attack a creature you can see within 15 feet of you. Each tentacle makes a melee attack roll with a +9 bonus. On a hit, the tentacle deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. If you hit a target with all three tentacles, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature’s speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it can’t use reactions for 1 minute. Moreover, on each of its turns, it can take either an action or a bonus action, but not both. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

[![Tentacle Rod](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-086-tentacle-rod.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-086-tentacle-rod.png)

### [Tome of Clear Thought](#ref:magic_item:4781-tome-of-clear-thought "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4781-tome-of-clear-thought") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TomeofClearThoughtrefmagicitem4781tomeofclearthoughthttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4781tomeofclearthought}

_Wondrous item, very rare_

This book contains memory and logic exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Intelligence score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

### [Tome of Leadership and Influence](#ref:magic_item:4782-tome-of-leadership-and-influence "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4782-tome-of-leadership-and-influence") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TomeofLeadershipandInfluencerefmagicitem4782tomeofleadershipandinfluencehttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4782tomeofleadershipandinfluence}

If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Charisma score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

[![Tome of Clear Thought](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-087-tome-of-thought.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-087-tome-of-thought.png)

[![Tome of Leadership](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-088-tome-leadership.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-088-tome-leadership.png)

[![Tome of Understanding](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-089-tome-of-understanding.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-089-tome-of-understanding.png)

### [Tome of the Stilled Tongue](#ref:magic_item:5409-tome-of-the-stilled-tongue "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5409-tome-of-the-stilled-tongue") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TomeoftheStilledTonguerefmagicitem5409tomeofthestilledtonguehttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5409tomeofthestilledtongue}

_Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement by a wizard)_

This thick leather-bound volume has a desiccated tongue pinned to the front cover. Five of these tomes exist, and it’s unknown which one is the original. The grisly cover decoration on the first _tome of the stilled tongue_ once belonged to a treacherous former servant of the lich-god Vecna, keeper of secrets. The tongues pinned to the covers of the four copies came from other spellcasters who crossed Vecna. The first few pages of each tome are filled with indecipherable scrawls. The remaining pages are blank and pristine.

If you can attune to this item, you can use it as a spellbook and an [**arcane focus**](#ref:equipment:215-arcane-focus "https://www.dndbeyond.com/equipment/215-arcane-focus"). In addition, while holding the tome, you can use a bonus action to cast a spell you have written in this tome, without expending a spell slot or using any verbal or somatic components. Once used, this property of the tome can’t be used again until the next dawn.

While attuned to the book, you can remove the tongue from the book’s cover. If you do so, all spells written in the book are permanently erased.

Vecna watches anyone using this tome. He can also write cryptic messages in the book. These messages appear at midnight and fade away after they are read.

### [Tome of Understanding](#ref:magic_item:4783-tome-of-understanding "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4783-tome-of-understanding") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TomeofUnderstandingrefmagicitem4783tomeofunderstandinghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4783tomeofunderstanding}

_Wondrous item, very rare_

This book contains intuition and insight exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Wisdom score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

### [Trident of Fish Command](#ref:magic_item:4784-trident-of-fish-command "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4784-trident-of-fish-command") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-s-t:TridentofFishCommandrefmagicitem4784tridentoffishcommandhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4784tridentoffishcommand}

_Weapon (trident), uncommon (requires attunement)_

This trident is a magic weapon. It has 3 charges. While you carry it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast [**dominate beast**](#ref:spell:2076-dominate-beast "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2076-dominate-beast") (save DC 15) from it on a beast that has an innate swimming speed. The trident regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

[![Trident of Fish Command](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-090-trident-fish-command.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-090-trident-fish-command.png)

This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. You can use an action to pour the contents of the tube onto a surface within reach. The liquid instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including [**sovereign glue**](#ref:magic_item:4756-sovereign-glue "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4756-sovereign-glue").

[![Universal Solvent](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-091-universal-solvent.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-091-universal-solvent.png)

[![Vorpal Sword](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-093-vorpal-sword.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-093-vorpal-sword.png)

### [Vorpal Sword](#ref:magic_item:5397-vorpal-sword "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5397-vorpal-sword") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:VorpalSwordrefmagicitem5397vorpalswordhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5397vorpalsword}

_Weapon (any sword that deals slashing damage), legendary (requires attunement)_

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistance to slashing damage.

When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature’s heads. The creature dies if it can’t survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn’t have or need a head, has legendary actions, or the DM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage from the hit.

## Magic Items (W) {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:MagicItemsW}

### [Wand of Binding](#ref:magic_item:4788-wand-of-binding "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4788-wand-of-binding") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WandofBindingrefmagicitem4788wandofbindinghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4788wandofbinding}

_Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster)_

This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

_**Spells.**_ While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 17): [**hold monster**](#ref:spell:2146-hold-monster "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2146-hold-monster") (5 charges) or [**hold person**](#ref:spell:2147-hold-person "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2147-hold-person") (2 charges).

_**Assisted Escape.**_ While holding the wand, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and gain advantage on a saving throw you make to avoid being [**paralyzed**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#paralyzedcondition) or [**restrained**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#restrainedcondition), or you can expend 1 charge and gain advantage on any check you make to escape a grapple.

### [Wand of Enemy Detection](#ref:magic_item:4789-wand-of-enemy-detection "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4789-wand-of-enemy-detection") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WandofEnemyDetectionrefmagicitem4789wandofenemydetectionhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4789wandofenemydetection}

_Wand, rare (requires attunement)_

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to speak its command word. For the next minute, you know the direction of the nearest creature hostile to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you. The wand can sense the presence of hostile creatures that are ethereal, [**invisible**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#invisiblecondition), disguised, or hidden, as well as those in plain sight. The effect ends if you stop holding the wand.

[![Wands Top to Bottom: Binding, EnemyDetection, Fear, Fireballs, and Polymorph](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-094-wands-binding-detection-fear-fireballs-polymorph.png)](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/dmg-2014/p3zgl8RSeMJYguMY/07-094-wands-binding-detection-fear-fireballs-polymorph.png)

The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

### [Wand of Fear](#ref:magic_item:4790-wand-of-fear "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4790-wand-of-fear") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WandofFearrefmagicitem4790wandoffearhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4790wandoffear}

_Wand, rare (requires attunement)_

This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

_**Command.**_ While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 1 charge and command another creature to flee or grovel, as with the [**command**](#ref:spell:2032-command "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2032-command") spell (save DC 15).

_**Cone of Fear.**_ While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 2 charges, causing the wand’s tip to emit a 60-foot cone of amber light. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become [**frightened**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#frightenedcondition) of you for 1 minute. While it is [**frightened**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#frightenedcondition) in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can’t willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can’t take reactions. For its action, it can use only the [**Dash**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#dashaction) action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can use the [**Dodge**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#dodgeaction) action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

### [Wand of Fireballs](#ref:magic_item:4791-wand-of-fireballs "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4791-wand-of-fireballs") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WandofFireballsrefmagicitem4791wandoffireballshttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4791wandoffireballs}

For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend.

The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

### [Wand of Wonder](#ref:magic_item:4800-wand-of-wonder "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4800-wand-of-wonder") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WandofWonderrefmagicitem4800wandofwonderhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4800wandofwonder}

_Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster)_

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges and choose a target within 120 feet of you. The target can be a creature, an object, or a point in space. Roll d100 and consult the following table to discover what happens.

If the effect causes you to cast a spell from the wand, the spell’s save DC is 15. If the spell normally has a range expressed in feet, its range becomes 120 feet if it isn’t already.

If an effect covers an area, you must center the spell on and include the target. If an effect has multiple possible subjects, the DM randomly determines which ones are affected.

The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into dust and is destroyed.

You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the weapon’s rarity.

### [Weapon of Warning](#ref:magic_item:5504-weapon-of-warning "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/5504-weapon-of-warning") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WeaponofWarningrefmagicitem5504weaponofwarninghttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems5504weaponofwarning}

_Weapon (any), uncommon (requires attunement)_

This magic weapon warns you of danger. While the weapon is on your person, you have advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, you and any of your companions within 30 feet of you can’t be [**surprised**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/basic-rules/combat#surprise), except when [**incapacitated**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/rules-glossary#incapacitatedcondition) by something other than nonmagical sleep. The weapon magically awakens you and your companions within range if any of you are sleeping naturally when combat begins.

### [Well of Many Worlds](#ref:magic_item:4802-well-of-many-worlds "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4802-well-of-many-worlds") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WellofManyWorldsrefmagicitem4802wellofmanyworldshttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4802wellofmanyworlds}

_Wondrous item, legendary_

This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.

You can use an action to unfold and place the _well of many worlds_ on a solid surface, whereupon it creates a two-way portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads. You can use an action to close an open portal by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Once _well of many worlds_ has opened a portal, it can’t do so again for 1d8 hours.

### [Wind Fan](#ref:magic_item:4803-wind-fan "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4803-wind-fan") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WindFanrefmagicitem4803windfanhttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4803windfan}

While holding this fan, you can use an action to cast the [**gust of wind**](#ref:spell:2134-gust-of-wind "https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2134-gust-of-wind") spell (save DC 13) from it. Once used, the fan shouldn’t be used again until the next dawn. Each time it is used again before then, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working and tearing into useless, nonmagical tatters.

### [Winged Boots](#ref:magic_item:4804-winged-boots "https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/4804-winged-boots") {#dmg-2014:magic-items-u-z:WingedBootsrefmagicitem4804wingedbootshttpswwwdndbeyondcommagicitems4804wingedboots}

_Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)_

While you wear these boots, you have a [**flying**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/basic-rules/combat#flyingmovement) speed equal to your walking speed. You can use the boots to fly for up to 4 hours, all at once or in several shorter flights, each one using a minimum of 1 minute from the duration. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.

The boots regain 2 hours of flying capability for every 12 hours they aren’t in use.

The wings give you a [**flying**](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/basic-rules/combat#flyingmovement) speed of 60 feet. When they disappear, you can’t use them again for 1d12 hours.
